# Invoiceo

> Invoiceo is free, open-source (MIT) offline billing and GST invoice software for Windows, macOS and Linux, made by Madcreations (India). It creates invoices, quotations and payment receipts, prints on A4/A5/A6 paper or 58/80 mm thermal printers, and works in English, Tamil, Hindi, Nepali, French, Spanish, Chinese and Tibetan (partly translated). All business data is stored on the user's own computer. The app is free with no subscription; custom features are a paid service quoted per request.

## Full text

- [llms-full.txt](https://invoiceo.in/llms-full.txt): the site's main text in one Markdown file: features, install steps for each system, every FAQ answer, privacy, terms of use, customization, contact, release notes and licences

## Key facts

- Price: free, no subscription; paid customization on request
- Open source: MIT License
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 12 or later, Linux (.deb and AppImage)
- Works offline; no online account needed
- GST: GSTIN, HSN/SAC, CGST + SGST or IGST, Tax Invoice / Bill of Supply titles
- Current version: 1.0.8 (28 October 2026)
- Based on Invoiso by ANOOP P (MIT License)
